name: Bambino Agro Industries Limited
about: Bambino Agro Industries Limited manufactures and sells food products in India. The company offers vermicelli, macaroni, spaghetti, roasted vermicelli, wheat rice, noodles, soups, breakfast mixes, sweet mixes, namkeens, spices, sweets, hing products, and pasta products under the Bambino brand name. It also exports its products to the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Israel, the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Bahrain, Kuwait, Qatar, Kenya, Seychelles, Mauritius, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Singapore, Malaysia, Brunei, the Philippines, Indonesia, Cambodia, Japan, Australia, and New Zealand. The company was founded in 1982 and is based in Secunderabad, India.
